questions.question: Explain oral communication.
questions.solution_html:
• communication.
  • Oral communication is the exchange of information through spoken words.
  • It includes conversations, meetings, presentations, speeches, and telephone
  • calls. It allows immediate feedback and clarification, making it an effective
  • method of communication. Features include quick interaction, personal
  • contact, and emotional expression. Effective oral communication requires
  • clear speech, confidence, proper tone, and active listening.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: clear speech, confidence, proper tone, and active listening.

questions.question: Discuss the role of rhythm in effective speech.
questions.solution_html:
• speech.
  • Rhythm in speech refers to the pattern of stressed and unstressed sounds
  • that create flow and clarity in speaking. A good rhythm helps maintain
  • audience interest and improves the effectiveness of communication. It
  • involves proper pacing, pauses, emphasis, and variation in tone. Rhythm
  • makes speech more engaging, easier to understand, and memorable.
  • Effective speakers use rhythm to highlight key points and maintain audience
  • attention.
